shared_elements: stylized tree with schematic repeating foliage
patterned scale-like or overlapping infill on a surface (feathers / fleece)
low-relief frieze of figures in profile facing one direction
figure with arm extended toward an adjacent element
justification: Both show profile figures in a shallow frieze standing beside a highly stylized tree rendered as tightly repeated leaf/palmette units, with the same conventions for curled hair, patterned garment or pelt infill, and outlined musculature, which is a fairly specific shared manner of depiction. The chief difference in content is that A depicts a single winged, animal-headed hybrid holding a bucket before the tree, while B depicts a narrative procession of ordinary bearded men leading horned rams above a rosette border.
